carmen: Postmortem follow-up: recurring overnight model-load spikes -> short 503 windows. Need concise runbook edits + small triage scripts. Target: two-week ship.

carmen: Proposed tasks:
- Playbook edits: escalation ladder (0/2/10 mins) + phone matrix. owner: reza. due: 2024-12-07
- `triage-fast.sh`: health, metrics p50/p95, logs grab. owner: sam. due: 2024-12-07
- CronJob warmup: pre-load at 23:50. owner: eng-sre. due: 2024-12-10
- Fallback route: route to standby model variant. owner: carmen. due: 2024-12-14

carmen: Minimal triage snippet to include in script:
curl -fsS https://api.redwood/health || echo "health failed"
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p50" | jq .
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200

sam: Taking the triage script. Will not hardcode tokens; script reads METRICS_KEY or prompts. Will add `--quick` flag.

reza: I'll draft the playbook. Short path first, then expanded SRE steps. Will include pager escalation and CI smoke gate.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-340. Tabletop scheduled: 2024-12-05 15:00 UTC.
